reason: The plugin is a meta-skill that mainly routes agent tasks to the right capabilities, using a configurable policy and a laziness policy to minimize unnecessary skill loading. It also includes install governance (quarantine, scan, and human confirmation) and installed-skill maintenance features, making its user-facing role one of agent workflow orchestration rather than direct content editing or data manipulation.

summaries.zh: skill-bartender 是一个面向智能体的元技能，通过可配置路由策略为任务选择最合适的技能并执行最小加载策略，同时提供带人工确认的新增技能导入检查流程。
summaries.en: skill-bartender is an agent meta-skill that routes tasks to the minimal suitable skill workflow using a configurable policy, and supports an approval-gated flow for bringing in new skills.

capabilities: Task-to-skill routing with a configured policy map to prefer minimal or workflow-level skill selection.
Optional audit/rewrite flow for installed skill descriptions to improve when-to-use guidance.
Missing-skill handling flow including quarantine, scanning, and human confirmation before installation.
Logging of unused skill loads to reduce future routing actions.
Multi-platform skill packaging for DSH, Claude Code, and Codex.
